items.title: Live-site accessibility audit with assistive technologies and representative devices
items.approvalEvidence: September 10 isolated Chromium/Firefox/WebKit review: 35 baseline passes; real mobile-bar contrast issue fixed; 16 targeted retests pass with zero axe violations in recorded scans. Keyboard/focus/error/reduced-motion/reflow/text-spacing and Chromium forced-colors evidence in qa/privacy-a11y-0910/review.md. Owner reports visual/touch pass on iPhone 15 Pro Max with newest iOS (exact version unverified), explicitly without VoiceOver. Authenticated production Chrome keyboard/DOM review covered both planner previews, validation, summary/privacy focus and collection state; see qa/privacy-a11y-0910/production-keyboard-review.md. Spoken VoiceOver remains unverified; native connection timed out. Incomplete/manual criteria remain; no conformance certification.
